title: Typo Correction Cost
description: An automated text correction system needs to transform an incoming misspelled word into a standard dictionary word using the minimum number of single-character operations. You are allowed three operations on a word: insert a character, delete a character, or replace a character. Given two words, word1 and word2, return the minimum number of operations required to convert word1 to word2.
constraints: word1 and word2 consist of lowercase English letters.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum edit distance

examples.explanation:
horse -> rorse (replace 'h' with 'r')
rorse -> rose (remove 'r')
rose -> ros (remove 'e')

intention -> inention (remove 't')
inention -> enention (replace 'i' with 'e')
enention -> exention (replace 'n' with 'x')
exention -> exection (replace 'n' with 'c')
exection -> execution (insert 'u')
Words are identical, zero operations needed.
